heading: Download engine
loadFailed: Failed to load the download queue

disabled.title: Download engine is disabled
disabled.hint: Open "Engine settings" at the top right, turn on "Enable download engine" and restart asmoday.

dialog.title: New download
dialog.uriHint: One per line. HTTP/HTTPS, magnet links and bare 40-character info hashes are supported.
dialog.defaultDir: Default directory (add save directories in engine settings)

settings.title: Engine settings
settings.rootsHint: Pick a mount point from File Manager and an optional subfolder. A `dir` passed over RPC must live inside these.
settings.restartHint: The enable switch, connections, concurrency and BT ports are read at startup — restart asmoday after changing them. Save directories apply immediately.
settings.restartPending: Saved. Takes effect after a restart.
settings.rootsEmpty: No save directory yet — pick a mount point below.
settings.subtitle: Parameters take effect after a restart; save directories apply immediately
settings.backHint: Each section saves on its own; directories and trackers apply immediately
settings.unsavedHint: You still have unsaved changes — save them before leaving
settings.unsavedBody: These changes have not been saved and will be discarded:
settings.enableHint: When off, this page is read-only and RPC is disabled too
settings.enableBtHint: Required for magnets and .torrent files; without it only HTTP links work
settings.disableDhtHint: Find peers through trackers only — useful on restricted or DHT-polluted networks

rpc.title: RPC access
rpc.hint: Point AriaNg / Aria2 Explorer at this address and secret to drive the same queue — changes show up here immediately.
rpc.rotateHint: The server generates this secret and keeps it in the database. Rotating invalidates the old one immediately — connected clients must be updated.
rpc.rotated: Secret rotated; the old one no longer works

trackers.title: BitTorrent trackers
trackers.hint: One per line, appended to every new download's announce list (same as aria2's bt-tracker); trackers inside the torrent are kept. Torrents already running are not touched — re-add them to pick up the new list.
trackers.saved: Trackers saved, effective for new torrents
trackers.btOff: BitTorrent is off — enable it above and restart asmoday.
